tasks.acceptance: Runs FIRST, alone. Build a scratch integrated build with core only: python3 dev/eos_integrate.py --dev-dir /tmp/eos_foundation --modules 00_eos_core.jsx, then import dev/eos_drive.mjs. (1) finishGame(page,id) drives to stage-reveal at 1280x860 AND 390x844 for: 1 POP (tap), 2 CRUSH (taps), 3 CRACK (tool then taps), 7 PIN POP (drag), 24 SLINGSHOT (sling), 11 PRESSURE POP (holdRelease), 18 BURN (hold), 21 BIN (dragTo), 36 CLOUD PASS (slow), 25 SWIPE AWAY (swipe), 19 ERASE (tool then scrub), 64 RED LIGHT (timing/lit), 67 TAP OUT (alt), 32 PARK IT (choose), 14 CRUMPLE (seq), 66 BUFFERING (wait), 50 UNFINISHED SENTENCE (type), 100 HOT POTATO, 109 CLEANSE, 110 RAIN OUT; it reads stages from window.__eos.arrows.EOS_GESTURES when present, otherwise from a copy of §3.11 bundled in eos_drive, and from [data-eos-target] markers for ids >= 111. The per-stage arrow assertion (arrows.state().visible + label) is enabled automatically when window.__eos.arrows exists and skipped otherwise. (2) listGames returns 110 unique names. (3) smallText(12) returns an array of {selector,text,px}; noShrink('/tmp/eos_base') compares rendered sizes against a baseline build made with python3 build.py --dev-dir /tmp/eos_base --modules 00_eos_core.jsx and returns [] for the baseline against itself. (4) lintCopy flags a planted 'calm down' and does not flag EOS_DISCLAIMER. (5) flashCheck returns a per-second count of large luminance jumps. (6) launchEos({timezoneId:'America/Toronto'}) sets the page time zone. (7) python3 dev/eos_preview.py --id 111 builds into /tmp/eos_preview_111 and renders the 'no engine registered' message with zero page errors. (8) window.__eosArrowMiss is initialised to [] before load. Zero edits outside dev/.
